proposed_fixes.title: PowerToys Run ranks an unrelated Store app above a URL query
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The application index can supply a UWP app result that fuzzy ranking treats as a better match for a partial URL token such as github.c, especially when similarly named apps are installed.
plan: Trace indexed application candidates and scoring for github., github.c, and github.com with the named Store app installed.
Avoid promoting unrelated app-name matches above a valid URL handler when the query is URL-like.
Add ranking regression tests with an unrelated UWP app and a matching URI handler.
verification: With the unrelated Store app installed, type github.com and verify the default browser URL result outranks the app.

comment.body: Thanks for testing `github.`/`github.c` on v0.73 and confirming the `github.c` result again on v0.85.1. Could you confirm the current PowerToys version, whether Windows File Manager is still installed, and the first result for those three exact queries? This distinguishes a persistent URL-vs-app ranking issue from an index change.
